caption:
SUMMER PASTA SALAD
This salad is cooling, gives you a great variety to choose any veges you want and is 100% vegan :) 

You can add some cheese into it though if you aren't on a diet like me ;) 

Ingredients: 
Salad: 
-80 grams of pasta, weigh before cooking :) 
- 1 lettuce, hand shredded
- 1 capsicum, sliced
- 1 tomato, sliced
- a few pieces of brocolli florettes, blanched and cooled

Dressing: 
- 4 tbsp olive oil
- 2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
- 1 tsp whole grain mustard
- a squeeze of lime
- pinch of salt and pepper

Method: 

As shown in the video :)
